text.p: These are the leading stories in the Mozambican press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Mozambique's Ministry of Housing and Public Works says its 1997 road rehabilitation and maintenance programme could be delayed because agreement has not been reached with financial institutions on US$30 million required for the work.

- Mozambique's main opposition party, Renamo, says local party leaders cancelled anti-government marches in the central province of Sofala last Saturday because no officials were available to receive a petition. They were all in the capital Maputo for a congress of the ruling Frelimo party. Several Renamo marches have been broken up by police this month for legal reasons. Ironically Saturday's planned demo was judged perfectly legal and police even provided an escort.
